MEILINMOD-XIANGZU_LEGACY_RELIC.title: Legacy of Xiang Clan
MEILINMOD-XIANGZU_LEGACY_RELIC.descripti: At the start of combat, gain [gold]Legacy of Xiang Clan[/gold].
MEILINMOD-XIANGZU_LEGACY_RELIC.flavor: The incense line endures, and so does its Qi.
MEILINMOD-XIANGZU_SPIRIT_RELIC.title: Xiang Clan Spirit
MEILINMOD-XIANGZU_SPIRIT_RELIC.descripti: At the start of combat, gain [gold]Legacy of Xiang Clan[/gold], and reduce Qi counters needed to gain Qi by 1.
MEILINMOD-XIANGZU_SPIRIT_RELIC.flavor: Even without the old relic, the spirit keeps breathing.
